title: 第7章 女子双打不留情第8章 四重极境小霸天
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
两只五尾狐相互配合，很快布置好了迷魂阵。
他们很好奇落尘如何破阵。
阵中，落尘环视了一周，嘴角露出一丝笑容。
突然间，挥动菜刀砍向几处。
手起刀落，迷雾散尽！
不到三息，阵破！
找到阵眼，挥刀就砍！
落尘的破阵方法，简单粗暴实用。
众兽大眼瞪小眼，面面相觑。
两只五尾狐更是目瞪口呆，他们的看家本领，只是一瞬间就被六岁的小孩破解了，不敢置信。
“糊弄三岁小孩呢？我都六岁了！
你俩布置的破阵，一点挑战性也没有！”
落尘指着五尾狐，很不满。
“老大，这是我们临时布置的最厉害的阵法了……真的。
老大太牛逼！
太牛逼了……”
一只五尾狐慌忙解释。
“不是阵法不厉害，是老大太厉害！”
“是啊，老大无所不能……”
……

其他妖兽也纷纷附和，极尽吹捧之能。
落尘有点飘了，挺着胸，背着小手，摇头晃脑道：
“嗯，菜刀在手，天下我有，本老大确实很牛逼。
我的理想是……”
“你的理想是天天挨揍！”
落尘牛逼没吹完，仙鹤出现在头顶，俩师姐从天而降。
一人揪着一只耳朵，不由分说，拎着他就走。
竹屋里，女子双打一点也不含糊，落尘不断求饶：
“师姐，轻点，轻点！
屁股都打肿了，哎呦……”
“叫你往外跑，叫你往外跑！”
“师尊闭关，没有人能管你了是不？”
清婉和紫嫣一边说，一边不断地挥动小手，巴掌狠狠落下，毫不留情。
她们真的气坏了。
“谁让你们的破阵法啥也不是的，还怨我跑！”
求饶不成，落尘开始耍赖。
“谁说她们的破阵法啥也不是？”
一道婉转的声音悠扬盈耳，白裙女子翩然而至。
“师尊，您可出关了，您不在，她们天天欺负我……
这，您都亲眼看见了，屁股都打肿了。
content_en:
The two five-tailed foxes cooperated with each other and quickly set up the enchantment array.
They were curious about how Luochen could break the formation.
In the formation, Luochen looked around with a smile on his face.
Suddenly, he swung his kitchen knife and struck several places.
With the sword raised and dropped, the fog dissipates!
In less than three breaths, the formation broke!
Find the formation's eye and slash with your sword!
Luochen's method of breaking the formation is simple, crude and practical.
The beasts stared at each other with big eyes and small eyes.
The two five-tailed foxes were even more stunned. Their special skills were cracked by a six-year-old child in just an instant. They couldn't believe it.
"What about fooling a three-year-old? I'm already six!
The breaking formation you two arranged is not challenging at all! "
Luochen pointed at the five-tailed fox and was very dissatisfied.
"Boss, this is the most powerful formation we have temporarily deployed...really.
The boss is so awesome!
So cool..."
A five-tailed fox explained hurriedly.
"It's not that the formation is not powerful, it's that the boss is too powerful!"
"Yes, the boss is omnipotent..."
…
Other monsters also echoed, trying their best to flatter.
Luochen was a little drifting. He held out his chest, clasped his little hands behind his back, shook his head and said:
"Well, I have the kitchen knife in my hand, and I have it all in the world. This boss is really awesome.
My ideal is..."
"Your ideal is to be beaten every day!"
Before Luochen finished boasting, the crane appeared above his head, and the two senior sisters descended from the sky.
One person grabbed one of his ears and without any explanation, carried him away.
In the bamboo house, the women's doubles match was unambiguous, and Luochen kept begging for mercy:
"Sister, be gentle, be gentle!
My butt is swollen from the spanking, oops..."
"I told you to run out, I told you to run out!"
"Master is in seclusion, no one can control you, right?"
Qingwan and Ziyan kept waving their little hands while talking, and slapped them down hard without mercy.
They were really pissed off.
"Who told me that your formation-breaking technique was useless and you blamed me for running away!"
When begging for mercy failed, Luochen began to cheat.
"Who says their formation-breaking techniques are useless?"
A melodious voice filled the ears, and a woman in a white dress came gracefully.
"Master, you are out of seclusion. They bully me every day while you are away...
You have seen this with your own eyes, your butt is swollen.
